segments.title: 第127章 你喜歡我?
segments.content:
Rekindling the Verdant Years Chapter 127: You Like Me?

The next morning, Li Luo woke up at six o'clock sharp. He knocked on Ying Chanxi's bedroom door, then began to wash up.

A moment later, Ying Chanxi, wearing her pajamas, walked into Li Luo's bedroom, went to his bathroom, and held out her toothbrush.

"What are you doing?"

"I'm out of toothpaste, give me a bit of yours."

"Here." Li Luo squeezed some toothpaste onto her toothbrush, then said, "Remember to buy a new one at the supermarket when you get back tonight."

"Got it." Ying Chanxi stuck the toothbrush in her mouth, showing no intention of leaving. She watched Li Luo wash his face while she brushed her teeth.

"Is this how you normally wash your face?" Watching Li Luo just splash water on his face a few times with his hands and then dry it with a towel, Ying Chanxi asked, looking speechless.

"How else?"

"Don't you have face wash?" Ying Chanxi glanced at the sink counter. Besides a bottle of hand soap, toothpaste, a toothbrush, and a cup, there really didn't seem to be anything else.

"I don't really use it."

"Then I'll buy one for you. I buy my dad's face wash for him."

"So I'm your..."

"Get lost!"

After washing up, Li Luo went to the balcony to get his clean school uniform and change into it.

Although the three of them all wore the same style of uniform, telling them apart was simple.

The largest size was definitely Li Luo's.

Ying Chanxi and Xu Youyu's sizes weren't much different, but because Xu Youyu's clothes had been worn for a long time, especially the short-sleeved shirts, they had very noticeable creases on the chest.

Ying Chanxi's didn't.

"Let's go." Ying Chanxi changed her shoes at the door, put on her backpack, and called out to Li Luo.

Li Luo answered, and followed Ying Chanxi out of the house.

The two of them walked together all the way to the school gate.

When they reached the school gate, they saw Yan Zhusheng waiting quietly by the roadside.

Yan Zhusheng was wearing the Bluetooth earbuds Ying Chanxi had given her. When she saw Li Luo and Ying Chanxi walking over together, she paused for a moment, then waved at them.

"Zhusheng, what are you doing here?" Ying Chanxi jogged over and asked curiously, "Are you waiting for someone?"

"I'm waiting for you two." Yan Zhusheng blinked. "To go for a morning run together."

"Eh?" Ying Chanxi was taken aback, then slowly caught on. She narrowed her eyes at Li Luo, "Why didn't you tell me yesterday that Zhusheng would be coming for the morning run too?"

"Didn't I? I might have forgotten to mention it." Li Luo turned into an expert at playing dumb, waving his hand and walking into the school gate first. "Let's go, the sooner we run, the sooner we can get breakfast."

"Xixi, here." Yan Zhusheng took off one earbud, looked at Li Luo, then back at Ying Chanxi, and handed the earbud to her. "I really like the earbuds you gave me, they work great."

"Ah, thanks." Ying Chanxi happily took the earbud and put it in her ear. "I'm glad you like them, Zhusheng. I was worried this kind of Bluetooth earbud wouldn't be very good."

The two of them walked together, following behind Li Luo, listening to music as they headed toward the track.

Li Luo turned his head and saw this scene, especially the earbud in Ying Chanxi's ear, and felt like he was the one being left out.

The three of them soon arrived at the track.

With the First Affiliated High School's track being 400 meters per lap, Ying Chanxi's 1500-meter run was a little less than four laps.

As for Li Luo's 3000-meter run, he had to run a full seven and a half laps.

Before, when he went out for an evening jog with Yan Zhusheng, they would just run two or three laps for the sake of it.

There weren't many people on the track in the morning.

Besides some sports students doing their routine morning training, there was only a constant stream of students walking along Houde Road on their way to school.

The three of them ran their laps quietly. By comparison, Ying Chanxi had the weakest stamina, and she was already quite tired by the third lap.

But seeing Li Luo and Yan Zhusheng still maintaining a steady pace, Ying Chanxi gritted her teeth, tried her best to keep up, and finally completed a five-lap morning run.

"Wait... let me rest a bit... I'm so tired..." After finishing the run, Ying Chanxi felt her legs go soft. She subconsciously steadied herself on Li Luo's shoulder, half-leaning on him.

Li Luo turned his head to look at her.

Ying Chanxi's lips were slightly parted as she panted. Her cheeks were already flushed, and a few strands of hair on her forehead were stuck with sweat, giving her a unique charm.

Yan Zhusheng watched silently from the side, then walked over to Ying Chanxi and helped her take off the earbud. "You can't wear this in the cafeteria."

"Feeling better?" Li Luo supported her as they walked towards the cafeteria. "In your condition, when you have to run the 1500 meters at full speed, won't you just collapse right after?"

"You should... worry about yourself first..." Ying Chanxi placed one hand on her hip and the other on Li Luo's shoulder. She panted for a while and finally felt a bit better. "I only have 1500, but you have to run 3000 meters."

"I only signed up for the 3000 meters." Li Luo said with a chuckle, "But you also signed up for the 100-meter dash. You'll be competing with Yan Zhusheng then."

"Zhusheng is running the 100 meters?" Ying Chanxi looked at Yan Zhusheng in surprise, but then it made sense. "That's right, it looks like you ran five laps like it was nothing. You must be really good at running."

"She even broke the school record in middle school," Li Luo said. "As for you, you should pray you make it past the preliminary heats first."

There were 16 classes in their grade, with two competitors from each class.

Out of a total of 32 people, one had to finish in the top eight to make it to the finals.

That meant you had a much better chance of reaching the finals if you placed in the top two of your heat.

"Don't look down on me," Ying Chanxi huffed. "Don't forget, I got a placing in the 100 meters in middle school too."

"Yes, yes, I underestimated you."

The three of them went to the cafeteria. After breakfast, they headed to their respective classrooms for morning self-study.

But before morning self-study even began, Li Luo went out to the restroom. When he came out, his path was blocked by a familiar figure.

"Li Luo, I asked your classmates." Lu Wei stood in front of him, chuckling. "You only signed up for the 3000 meters for the sports meet, right? I signed up for the 3000 meters this time too. Let's see who gets a higher ranking."

"..." Li Luo looked at Lu Wei, speechless. He really couldn't understand how someone so bizarre could exist at the First Affiliated High School. "Dude, can you stop being so childish?"

"Are you a man or not? Don't run from my challenge." Lu Wei pointed at Li Luo. "If you lose this time, can you stop talking to Gao Yuqin in the future?"

"I don't even talk to her in the first place."

"Then why did she say you specifically told her that you're still single?"

Li Luo: "...?"

Why is this Gao Yuqin so manipulative?

Yan Zhusheng, who was next to him, saw his expression and asked curiously, "What's wrong?"

"Nothing, I just suddenly feel that a girl with your kind of personality is better."

"You like me?"

"...What kind of logic led you to that conclusion?"

(End of Chapter)
